entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Sehr Gut #33279
  • error when using Xaml SourceGen generating .xaml.xsg.cs with float value #33277
  • [SafeArea] [Android] Padding not restored after SoftInput closes #33276
  • [Windows] Maui Stepper is not clamped to minimum or maximum internally #33274
  • [Catalyst] CarouselView item content is clipped in CV1 #33272
  • PointerGestureRecognizer is never fired when the view has a PanGestureRecognizer attached #33270

Closed

  • App hangs if PopModalAsync is called after PushModalAsync with single await Task.Yield() #32310
    Backlog
  • Implement `UseMaterial3` MSBuild property to enable M3 at build time #33073
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • PointerGestureRecognizer is never fired when the view has a PanGestureRecognizer attached #33269

PullRequests

Created

  • [Windows] Maui Stepper: Clamp minimum and maximum value #33275
    platform/windows, community ✨, area-controls-stepper
  • [Testing] Re-saved ShouldFlyoutBeVisibleAfterMaximizingWindow test case images in PR 33185 - [12/22/2025] Candidate #33271
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix #33264 - RadioButtonGroup not working with Colle… #33268
    platform/macos, platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-radiobutton

Merged

  • Split iOS device tests by category in Helix #33263
  • [Android] Implemented `UseMaterial3` build property and provided basic M3 styles #33074
    platform/android, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 33185 - [12/22/2025] Candidate #33257
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion

Updated

  • Fix iOS integration tests on Apple Silicon and add individual test lanes #33251
  • [Android] Fix for SafeAreaEdges works correctly only on the first tab in Shell. Other tabs have content colliding with the display cutout in the landscape mode. #33086
    platform/android, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, area-safearea
  • Add comprehensive UI tests for keyboard behavior with SoftInput modes on Android #33145
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Android] Fixed Label Overlapped by Android Status Bar When Using SafeAreaEdges="Container" in .NET MAUI #33014
    platform/android, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, area-safearea
  • [Mac, iOS, Windows] Fix for inconsistent Text-to-Speech rate behavior #32850
    platform/windows, platform/ios, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, area-essentials-texttospeech
  • [Android] CollectionView selection with drag/drop gestures on Android - fix #32811
    area-controls-collectionview, community ✨
  • [iOS] Fixed Flyout icon not updating when root page changes using InsertPageBefore #29924
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-flyout, partner/syncfusion
  • ScrollView's ScrollToAsync doesn't complete when called thrice with the same value #27300
    platform/macos, platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-scrollview, partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS] Fixed the ConnectivityChanged event is not triggered when toggling Wifi (turning it on or off) #29606
    area-essentials, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Fixed the Picker didn't dismiss it when tapping outside on iOS and MacCatalyst platform. #30067
    community ✨, area-controls-picker, partner/syncfusion
  • [Android] Exception thrown when give more than 5000 characters to the Text property of Entry. #30242
    community ✨, area-controls-entry, partner/syncfusion
  • CollectionView selecteditem background lost if collectionview (or parent) IsEnabled changed. #31540
    area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Fixed NavigationPage and FlyoutPage both call OnNavigatedTo, so it is called twice #31931
    area-navigation, area-controls-flyoutpage, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS,Windows] Fix navigation bar colors not resetting when switching ShellContent #33228
    platform/windows, platform/ios, area-controls-shell, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [XSG] Skip compiled binding when RelativeSource is used #33248
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2.1
  • Fixed IsEnabled Property not works on Tabs #26728
    area-controls-tabbedpage, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • December 22nd, Candidate #33185
  • [Windows/Mac] Fix RTL FlowDirection causes overlap with native window control buttons in TitleBar #30400
    platform/macos, platform/windows, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Testing] Fix for flaky UITests in CI - 5 #33259
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Set the CV2 handlers as the default #33177
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix Android drawable mutation crash in controls #33265
    platform/android, community ✨
